_comment: Start value and fit window of the burst-MLE wizard, as an AutoForm spec over the wizard itself (its tau, micro_time_start and micro_time_stop properties). Typed, clamped, Enter commits; a change is written to the wizard, which refits the current decay.

sections.description: Start lifetime and the micro-time window (bins) of the burst-wise lifetime MLE.
sections.title: Start value and fit window

buttons.label: Demo
buttons.description: Replace working inputs with 16 generated bursts of 1000 photons each and a known input lifetime of 2 ns. Fitting remains an explicit user action.

sections.label: Fit model
sections.description: Select the registered tttrlib lifetime estimator for the preview and batch fit. Fit23, Fit24 and Fit25 use the existing IRF/background facade. The existing tail fitter is preview-only. Each model retains its parameter edits.
Available registered models and required inputs of estimators unavailable here.
The actual current model's primary lifetime and score; Fit25 also reports its registered winning candidate index (0-based).

sections.label: Tau start [ns]
sections.description: Starting value of the lifetime in ns (the wizard's Tau start). A change refits the current decay.

sections.label: Window start [bin]
sections.description: First micro-time bin of the fit window (after binning). Leave out the empty bins before the prompt.

sections.label: Window stop [bin]
sections.description: Micro-time bin after the last bin of the fit window. Leave out the noisy tail.

sections.title: Fit parameters
sections.description: The selected model's free input parameters, starts, fixed flags and results. Double-click Start to edit; click Fixed to hold a fitted parameter. Fit25 candidate lifetimes are always fixed, with editable numeric values. Hover a row for its provider description.
Edit the selected model's free inputs and fixed flags. Candidate lifetimes remain fixed; results are read-only.

columns.title: Parameter
columns.tooltip: Free input parameter declared by the selected model.

columns.title: Start
columns.tooltip: Starting value, or candidate lifetime. Time values are in ns.

columns.title: Fixed
columns.tooltip: Hold at the starting value. Fit25 candidate lifetimes are always fixed.

columns.title: Result
columns.tooltip: Fitted value. Candidate lifetimes remain inputs; the Fit25 winner appears above.
